form.intro: Write your method down clearly: the knowbot's logic comes only from what you write. Where something is missing we will ask you rather than fill it in.
form.title: Name

q.steps: What are the steps, and which rule decides each step?
q.outputs: What does the output look like?
q.correctness: How do you know it is right?

form.casesHint: Give a few examples whose answers you know: what to ask, and what an item in the result should be. Only you can fill in the expected values (for example, figures you looked up in an annual report); we do not fill them in for you. Testing checks that it runs correctly, not the method itself.
form.question: Case {n}: what to ask
form.consent: I agree that the data I upload may be used to test this knowbot. The write-ups and step results of a test are shown only to me and to the staff running the test: I use them to accept the knowbot, the staff to check it works correctly. They are not used for training, not shown to other users and not used for anything else. They are deleted 90 days after the avatar is delivered or replaced by a newer one.
form.invalid: Something did not pass the checks. Please make sure every field is filled in and numbers are valid.
form.failed: Could not submit. Please try again later.

amend.title: Amend the method
amend.intro: If a test result makes you want to change a step, write it here: which step, what it should become, and why. Write the method only, no technical detail. We will hatch the next avatar accordingly and test it again. What you write cannot be edited; to take it back, write another one.
amend.label: Your amendment
amend.failed: It was not submitted. Please try again later.

knowbotData.title: My data
knowbotData.intro: Your data is used only for your own knowbots and their tests, never for anyone else. PDF, Excel, CSV and text only; up to 50 MB per file and 1 GB in total.
knowbotData.tableHint: For numbers, upload tables where you can (Excel or CSV): reporting periods across the first row, line items down the first column, one number per cell. Your knowbot then takes figures cell by cell and the platform computes them, so results are exact and checkable. A PDF can only be read as text; use it to cross-check a few figures.

avatars.title: Avatars

now.failed: Did not pass: see the reason under each case below. To change a step, write an amendment on the Ideas page and we will hatch the next avatar from it.
now.passed: Passed. It is being handed to knowmart to become an expert.
now.delivered: It has become an expert; you can summon it from the workbench.
